From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC preflight — environment dependencies & owners

Hi Dora — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps against the MAP milestone for POC environment setup so we have clear owners and dates. See attached draft MAP (acme_map_draft_v1.pdf) and the live checklist (Drive link below).

Key environment dependencies (owner / ask / target ETA):
- VPC peering (Acme infra): create peering connection and share peering ID + CIDR ranges for route table updates. ETA requested: within 3 business days after signoff.
- IP allowlists (Acme security): provide public IPs or NAT ranges we should allow; Redwood will provide egress endpoints. ETA: 1 business day after peering is confirmed.
- SSO / SAML test account (Acme identity): Acme to provide an Okta test tenant admin + metadata (IdP metadata XML / entity ID / ACS URL). Redwood will provide SP metadata. ETA: target within 5 business days but depends on change-control windows.
- Secrets / KMS (customer-managed): confirm whether Acme will provide a Customer-managed KMS key (ARN) or if you need Redwood-managed keys. If customer KMS: we need Key ARN and policy allowing Redwood service principal to encrypt/decrypt. ETA: align during preflight.

Proposed timeline & target close: POC infra complete -> readiness sign-off -> kickoff. Suggested target POC completion date: 2026-07-15 (flexible if your change-control requires more time).

Owners (proposed):
- Acme infra & network owner: Dora Patel / Acme SRE
- Acme identity owner: please confirm Okta admin contact
- Redwood infra lead: Karthik Iyer (cc'd)
- Redwood SSO integration: Naomi Feldman (coord)

Next steps I suggest:
1) Dora / Acme to confirm owners and provide SRE contact who can accept the VPC peering request (reply to this thread).
2) Acme to share Okta test tenant metadata (IdP XML or admin contact).
3) Redwood opens SUP ticket for infra work and shares endpoint IPs and SP metadata.
4) Schedule 30-minute preflight sync with Acme SRE + Redwood infra lead (please propose times).

Live checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPDraft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6227

Attaching: acme_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP, draft) and redwood_network_handbook_v2.pdf (network requirements excerpt).

Thanks — looking forward to confirmation so we can lock dates.

Best,

Hi Dora / Naomi — quick infra notes and an internal checklist to unblock the items Dora called out.

Checklist & technical details (Redwood <> Acme):
- VPC peering: Redwood will provide the peer request once Acme confirms target VPC ID + CIDR. We recommend adding a route for the following CIDR blocks on your side: 10.40.0.0/16 (Redwood-pool-1). Expect: peering acceptance + route table updates = 1–3 business days once Avail windows align.
- IP allowlist: Redwood egress endpoints (to be opened after SUP ticket is created) are: 34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46 (will publish full list in SUP ticket).
- SAML / Okta: we need either (a) IdP metadata XML, or (b) the following details: IdP entityID, SingleSignOnService (POST) URL, and X.509 cert. For SP side, we will supply ACS URL and SP entity ID. If Acme prefers, we can run initial exchange in a shared Okta test tenant — require admin invite (jenna.okta@acmehealth.com).
- KMS / secrets: Customer-managed KMS preferred. If Acme will provide: please share key ARN and confirm grant policy for Redwood service account. Alternatively, Redwood can generate ephemeral keys and restrict export — discuss in sync.

Proposed infra owner at Redwood: myself (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai) as day-to-day contact; I will escalate to Markus Klein for network changes if we hit quota/peering limits.

Timeline: based on typical windows, plan for peering + allowlist + SP metadata exchange = ~7–10 business days (depends on your change-control). If Acme needs extra time, we can shift POC completion to 2026-07-29. Please confirm preferred target.

I'll open SUP-1234 and attach the network diagram & endpoint list. Dora — can you confirm Samir's email so I can add him to the SUP ticket?

Thanks,
